title: Early Experience: Data Construction and Dual-Branch Training (IL→RL)

nodes.label: Expert Dataset D_expert
nodes.semantic_desc: Collection of expert state-action pairs {(s_i, a_i)}; provides expert states s_i and corresponding expert actions a_i to seed alternative-action sampling and later supervised training.
nodes.visual_desc: A database cylinder labeled 'D_expert' with two small columns indicated: s_i and a_i; clean minimal iconography.

nodes.label: Expert State s_i
nodes.semantic_desc: A single expert state from D_expert; used as conditioning context for action sampling and for comparison-based reflection generation.
nodes.visual_desc: A small rounded rectangle containing a compact 'state' glyph (e.g., stacked tokens or a simple observation icon) with label 's_i'.

nodes.label: Initial LLM Policy π0
nodes.semantic_desc: Pretrained/initial LLM policy; takes state s_i as prompt/context and outputs a distribution over candidate actions for sampling non-expert alternatives.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle module box with solid primary fill (#4A90D9) and white centered text 'Initial LLM Policy π0'; small transformer-block icon in a corner.

nodes.label: K Alternative Actions
nodes.semantic_desc: Set of K sampled non-expert candidate actions {a_i^1..a_i^K} generated by π0 conditioned on s_i; used for rollouts and later reflection/training.
nodes.visual_desc: A fan-out of K small action-token pills (a_i^1, a_i^2, …, a_i^K) arranged in a row; no extra text besides compact labels.

nodes.label: Environment Simulator
nodes.semantic_desc: Interactive environment; takes (state, action) and outputs next/forward state. Used to execute expert action a_i and each alternative a_i^j to obtain corresponding future states.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle with a small grid-world/physics icon (e.g., cube + arrow) and text 'Environment'. Neutral gray outline to distinguish from model modules.

nodes.label: Expert Next State s_{i+1}
nodes.semantic_desc: Future state resulting from executing expert action a_i in the environment from state s_i; serves as a reference outcome for comparison in self-reflection.
nodes.visual_desc: A state glyph similar to s_i but with a forward arrow overlay and label 's_{i+1}'.

nodes.label: Alt Next States s_i^j
nodes.semantic_desc: Set of future states {s_i^j} resulting from executing each alternative action a_i^j from state s_i; used as supervision targets for implicit world modeling and as comparison evidence for reflection.
nodes.visual_desc: A row/stack of small state glyphs with superscripts j (s_i^1, s_i^2, …) with faint branching arrows indicating multiple outcomes.

nodes.label: Rollout Triples D_rollout
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed dataset of rollout triples {(s_i, a_i^j, s_i^j)}; provides (s_i, a_i^j) inputs with future state s_i^j as reward-free supervision for dynamics internalization.
nodes.visual_desc: A database cylinder labeled 'D_rollout' with a tiny 3-tuple icon '(s, a, s′)' on its side.

nodes.label: IWM Branch
nodes.semantic_desc: Implicit World Modeling training branch; takes (s_i, a_i^j) from D_rollout and trains the LLM to predict future state s_i^j as next-token/text prediction, producing a dynamics-aware policy.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle with primary fill and white text 'IWM'; include a small next-token arrow icon (token → token) to denote language-modeling style prediction.

nodes.label: Future State Prediction
nodes.semantic_desc: Model-predicted representation/serialization of future state ŷs_i^j; compared against true s_i^j to provide supervision for IWM learning.
nodes.visual_desc: A small sheet/token strip icon showing 's_i^j' as generated text tokens; optionally a ghosted true/target strip behind it to imply prediction vs target.

nodes.label: NLL Loss (IWM)
nodes.semantic_desc: Negative log-likelihood objective; takes predicted future-state tokens and target future-state tokens (s_i^j) and outputs a scalar loss to update the policy in the IWM branch.
nodes.visual_desc: A small hexagon or diamond labeled 'NLL' with a tiny downward curve icon indicating optimization/minimization.

nodes.label: SR Branch
nodes.semantic_desc: Self-Reflection generation branch; takes (s_i, a_i, s_{i+1}) and (a_i^j, s_i^j) evidence and outputs natural-language rationale c_i^j explaining why the expert action is better.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle with accent outline (#fc8d62) and text 'SR'; include a small speech-bubble icon to denote explanation generation.

nodes.label: Reflection Text c_i^j
nodes.semantic_desc: Natural-language comparative explanation stating 'expert action is better' for each alternative j; used as an additional supervised target to align policy reasoning.
nodes.visual_desc: A speech bubble containing short dummy lines (no readable text) and a bold token 'c_i^j' beneath; clean paper-like styling.

nodes.label: Reflection Dataset D_refl
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed reflection dataset {(s_i, a_i^j, c_i^j)}; provides state-action alternatives with reflection text targets for joint training with expert actions.
nodes.visual_desc: A database cylinder labeled 'D_refl' with a small speech-bubble + action-token icon on its side.

nodes.label: Joint IL Training
nodes.semantic_desc: Joint supervised training stage; takes D_expert (to predict expert action a_i) and D_refl (to predict reflection text c_i^j) to update the LLM policy with both action imitation and reflective alignment.
nodes.visual_desc: A larger rounded rectangle split into two subtle lanes labeled 'predict a_i' and 'predict c_i^j'; primary fill with a thin accent stripe to indicate multi-task.

nodes.label: Updated LLM Policy π
nodes.semantic_desc: Final policy after Early Experience training; expected to encode environment dynamics (via IWM) and improved decision quality via self-reflection and expert imitation.
nodes.visual_desc: A prominent rounded rectangle with bold border, text 'LLM Policy π (trained)'; small combined icons (token arrow + speech bubble) in the corner.
